string-array.name: s08_steps_xiaomi
string-array.item: Open Settings → Apps → Manage apps → LightScout and turn on Autostart.
In LightScout\'s app settings, open Power (Zasilanie), then choose No restrictions under Battery saver.
Open recent apps, long-press the LightScout card and tap the lock icon.
In LightScout\'s app settings, tap Other permissions and allow Show on lock screen.
In Other permissions, also allow Display pop-up windows while running in background.
In LightScout\'s app settings, tap Notifications and turn on Floating notifications.
In Notifications, also turn on Lock screen notifications.

string-array.name: s08_steps_samsung
string-array.item: Open Settings → Apps → LightScout → Battery and choose Unrestricted.
Open Settings → Battery → Background usage limits and make sure LightScout is not in Sleeping apps or Deep sleeping apps.
In Background usage limits, turn off Put unused apps to sleep.

string-array.name: s08_steps_huawei
string-array.item: Open Settings → Battery → App launch, find LightScout and turn off Manage automatically.
In the window that opens, keep Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background turned on.
Open recent apps and lock LightScout by swiping down on its card.

string-array.name: s08_steps_oneplus
string-array.item: Open Settings → Apps → LightScout → Battery usage and turn on Allow background activity.
In Battery usage, also turn on Allow auto launch.
Open recent apps, tap the menu on the LightScout card and choose Lock.
